transcript.en: Remind me, Trevor...how long is the presentation?
transcript.zh: 特雷弗，提醒我一下，演讲要多长时间？

transcript.en: Dr White said three per hour.
transcript.zh: 怀特先生说一小时三个。

transcript.en: So about twenty minutes?
transcript.zh: 所以大约是20分钟。

transcript.en: Well...it'll be fifteen minutes per presentation.
transcript.zh: 每个演讲要15分钟。

transcript.en: And five minutes for questions.
transcript.zh: 另外5分钟用于提问？

transcript.en: And is this one going to be assessed?
transcript.zh: 这次要评分吗？

transcript.en: No...not this time round because it's the first one...you know.
transcript.zh: 不，这次不评分，因为这是第一次。

transcript.en: Good news.
transcript.zh: 好消息。

transcript.en: Well, Trevor, what are we going to include?
transcript.zh: 特雷弗，我们要说些什么？

transcript.en: Well...Do you think we ought to give some historical background?
transcript.zh: 你觉得我们应该说点历史背景吗？

transcript.en: Oh no...definitely not...we won't have time!
transcript.zh: 肯定不行，我们没时间了！

transcript.en: OK...but I think we ought to say something about the geographical location ... cos not a lot of people know where the islands are...
transcript.zh: 好的，但是我想我们应该说一下地理位置，因为很多人不知道那些岛屿在哪儿。

transcript.en: Yes...OK...I'll take notes, shall I?
transcript.zh: 好的，我来记笔记吧？

transcript.en: Yeah, that'll be a help...
transcript.zh: 好的，这很有帮助。

transcript.en: So...geographical location...
transcript.zh: 所以，地理位置。

transcript.en: Then we ought to give an overview of the whole education system.
transcript.zh: 之后我们要介绍整个教育系统的概况。

transcript.en: Shouldn't we say something about the economy...
transcript.zh: 我们要不要提一下经济问题？

transcript.en: you know agricultural produce, minerals and so forth?
transcript.zh: 比如农产品、矿物质之类的？

transcript.en: Well...Dr. White said we shouldn't go into that sort of detail.
transcript.zh: 怀特博士告诉我们不要讨论那些细节。

transcript.en: But it's pretty important when you think about it... you know because it does influence the education system...
transcript.zh: 但是当你想到它的时候，你会发现这很重要，因为它的确影响教育系统。

transcript.en: Look...let's think about that one later shall we?
transcript.zh: 让我们之后再想这个吧？

transcript.en: Let's see how we're doing for time...
transcript.zh: 看看还有没有时间。

transcript.en: OK...so...general overview of education.
transcript.zh: 好的，教育概述。

transcript.en: Of course ... and then the role of English language...
transcript.zh: 当然。然后是英文的角色。

transcript.en: Nope...that goes in the Language Policy Seminar...don't you remember?
transcript.zh: 不，那个将在语言政策讨论会上讲，你不记得了吗

transcript.en: Are you sure?
transcript.zh: 你确定吗？当然！

transcript.en: Positive.
transcript.zh: 好的，

transcript.en: All right...so those are the topics we're going to be...to be covering...
transcript.zh: 这些就是我们要讲的话题。

transcript.en: We need to think about what to prepare...
transcript.zh: 我们得想想要准备什么。

transcript.en: Dr. White said he wanted us to use plenty of visuals and things and we might as well try them out when we're not being assessed...
transcript.zh: 怀特博士说他想让我们多用一些视觉的东西，尤其是在不评分的时候还可以多尝试其他东西。

transcript.en: Well, the most important thing is the overhead projector...
transcript.zh: 最重要的是投影仪。

transcript.en: No problem...we'll get that from the media room...must remember to book it...
transcript.zh: 没问题，我们可以从媒体室拿，别忘了预定。

transcript.en: Well...we'll need a map of course.
transcript.zh: 我们当然还需要一张地图。

transcript.en: Probably two...one of the islands...large scale.
transcript.zh: 可能要两大张。一张是岛屿的。

transcript.en: And one of West Africa.
transcript.zh: 另一张是非洲西部。

transcript.en: Well, the West African one is no problem...there's one in the Resources Room.
transcript.zh: 非洲西部的没问题，资料室就有一张。

transcript.en: Oh yeah, of course, the resources room; the islands are going to be more of a problem.
transcript.zh: 是的，资料室。岛屿那张可能有点难找。

transcript.en: Tell you what...there's a very clear map of Santiago in that tourist brochure I showed you last week.
transcript.zh: 告诉你吧，在我上周给你看的旅游手册上有一幅非常清晰的圣地亚哥的地图，

transcript.en: Don't you remember it?
transcript.zh: 你记得吗？

transcript.en: Oh yeah...that's right; we can just use the tourist brochure.
transcript.zh: 没错。我们可以用旅游手册。

transcript.en: We also need statistics...on several different things.
transcript.zh: 我们还得在一些不同的事情上找些统计资料。

transcript.en: Literacy rates.
transcript.zh: 识字率。

transcript.en: Yes, and school places.
transcript.zh: 是的，还有学校的地点。

transcript.en: How about the encyclopaedia?
transcript.zh: 《百科全书》怎么样？

transcript.en: Nah...not up-to-date enough!
transcript.zh: 不行，不够与时俱进！

transcript.en: Mmm...why don't we call the embassy?
transcript.zh: 我们干嘛不给大使馆打电话？

transcript.en: Oh...someone's enthusiastic!
transcript.zh: 有人相当有激情啊！

transcript.en: Well...if something's worth doing...
transcript.zh: 如果事情值得做的话。

transcript.en: I know...it's worth doing well...OK.
transcript.zh: 我知道它值得做好。好的。

transcript.en: We can find out statistics on school places from them as well.
transcript.zh: 我们还能从他们那里得到学校分布地点的统计资料。

transcript.en: Might as well.
transcript.zh: 最好如此。

transcript.en: Look, Julie, it's almost time for our tutorials...we can meet again on Monday...but we need to prepare some stuff before then...
transcript.zh: 朱丽，快到我们上课的时间了。我们可以周一再见，但是我们在这之前要准备一些材料……
